This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sport arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. His previous owner describes him as social and affectionate. While in care, Sport has been observed to be very overaroused. Noted to be panting heavily, with wide dilated eyes and clown face throughout his assessment. When the handler initiated contact, Sport would begin spinning and shoulder rubbing. While on leash, Sport is reported to be highly dog and kennel reactive. Sported to pull towards other dogs constantly. Due to the detailed behavoior we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Sport
